cases.name: every inline draft script parses without executing Native/product
all operation actions including input handoff, take/delete and shortcuts remain byte identical
ACK resolves immediately and cancels timer while visual work remains deferred
timeout explicitly reports uncertain result; no retry and late ACK is ignored
late ACK for expired request cannot resolve a newer pending request
negative ACK preserves refusal and cancels timer without retry
send exception settles request and cleans pending/timer with uncertainty
old socket cannot acknowledge newer socket request
hidden window has bounded renderer set, state and ACK remain immediate
pagehide cancels pending requests, timers and paints; no reconnect or mutation retry
disconnect rejects pending and clears stale frame; retains existing reconnect policy only
visual exception cannot suppress another renderer or expose fixture error details
actual rendered PGM/Preview cards retain buttons/focus identity; close availability follows on-air state
mute updates Audio.on in place while keeping audio and GO node identity
recursive tally and PGM priority update existing classes, including mini cards
structural card mismatch safely uses full renderer once
queued structural paint supersedes tally update and paints final state once
actual metadata polling tally-only preserves card identity
actual metadata polling tag change requests structural paint

limits: Draft only; no product application, Native, CEF, network, operator actions or browser performance proof

Actual extracted draft req/connect/onEvent/lifecycle/helper/renderTiles/metadata executed in own VM with synthetic clock/socket and finite DOM; preserved focus property proves node identity only, not real browser focus/pointer behavior
Timeout is uncertainty, not cancellation; no retry of expired requests; existing transport reconnect retained
PGM/Preview/mute/recursive tally paints update cards in place; initial/imperative actions and other sync/poll paints retain existing flow
Structural mismatch, SceneList, tags, filter and minimize still rebuild cards; close button alone is removed/created according to on-air state
